tw: "Turn right!" says Kron, right, right, and his bright kite turns into a tight knot.
twc: Kron 右转右转再右转，亮闪闪的风筝拧成了死结。

tw: Kron grates a great plate of grapes for eight grey geese.
twc: Kron 给八只灰鹅擦了一大盘葡萄丝。
hint: 葡萄也能擦成丝，太棒了。

tw: Kron sits in a pretty kitty city, and fifty kitties sit on Kron.
twc: Kron 坐进了漂亮的猫猫城，五十只小猫全坐在他身上。
hint: 进了猫的城市，你就是坐垫。

tw: "Good morning!" Kron yells into a horn, and the horn honks more good mornings.
twc: Kron 对着喇叭喊早上好，喇叭回他一大串早上好。
hint: 早安喊出去，回来一大串。

tw: Kron's best subject: art! He paints a sub in a tub and a jet in jelly.
twc: Kron 最拿手美术：给澡盆里的潜艇、果冻里的飞机上色。

tw: Kron has many, many pennies, and a hen pecks at any penny he drops.
twc: Kron 有好多好多硬币，掉一枚，母鸡就啄走一枚。

tw: Kron and a worm work hard in the yard, and the worm digs to the car.
twc: Kron 和蚯蚓在院子里努力挖，蚯蚓一路挖到了汽车底下。

tw: Kron's turtle turns little turns on top of a purple kettle.
twc: Kron 的乌龟在紫色水壶顶上转小圈圈。

tw: How many cows? Right now many brown cows crowd into Kron's little house.
twc: 有多少头牛？此刻好多棕牛正挤进 Kron 的小屋。

tw: They pay Kron in hay to play, so they stay and sway all day.
twc: 他们用干草付钱请 Kron 演奏，于是整天留下来跟着摇摆。

tw: Kron sells a smelly shell, and the shell yells, "Help!"
twc: Kron 卖一只臭贝壳，贝壳大喊：“救命！”

tw: Kron tries to catch a fat cat, but the cat catches Kron in a hat.
twc: Kron 想抓一只胖猫，结果猫用帽子把 Kron 扣住了。

tw: "Go on your own," groans the goat, so Kron rows a boat alone.
twc: 山羊嘟囔：“你自己去吧。”于是 Kron 独自划船。

tw: The bears go up the stairs in pairs, and Kron pairs with a chair.
twc: 熊们两两一组上楼梯，Kron 只好跟一把椅子凑一组。

tw: "Try again!" cries Kron, trying to fry a pie high in the sky.
twc: “再试一次！”Kron 在高空热气球上一遍遍试着煎派。

tw: "Here!" cheers Kron, and the deer on his seat cheers "Here!" too.
twc: Kron 喊“到！”，坐在他座位上的鹿也喊“到！”

tw: Kron creeps near a big lion's ear, and the lion weeps a tear of fear.
twc: Kron 悄悄靠近大狮子的耳朵，狮子吓得掉了一滴泪。

tw: Kron hops from the bus top onto the bus stop with a big plop.
twc: Kron 从公交车顶一跃而下，扑通落在公交车站。

tw: Hungry Kron eats a hundred buns, and a grumpy bunny gets none.
twc: 饿坏的 Kron 吃掉一百个面包，气呼呼的兔子一个没捞着。
hint: 太饿了，一百个都不够分。
